title: Audit incremental session and composer publication cost from recorded browser profiles
outcome: Decide from isolated measurements whether existing incremental publication does avoidable work, preserving its current owner and correctness before proposing an optimization.
acceptance: The existing operator trace and synthetic profiles are reconciled with named source functions and per-event versus capture-wide self/inclusive timings; overlapping costs and instrumentation are stated explicitly.

A focused deterministic work-count or allocation diagnostic isolates any avoidable publication work across representative session counts and mutation patterns, without changing UI or authority semantics to improve a benchmark.

The result records either a measured, separately scoped optimization proposal with expected impact and validation, or evidence that no change is justified; no speculative cache, registry or authority is introduced.
disposal_reason: Continue as independent publication-cost research after profiling parent completed; preserve original measurements, criteria, limits and artifact-retention provenance.
